answer: New agents enter through a timber-bond registry, not a free sign-up form. First, each agent locks 500 POA for 30 days. Second, it completes three verified jobs checked by two established peers. Third, only after passing does it climb the mesa of trusted agents, gaining trading rights step by step. Forging 10,000 identities locks 5,000,000 POA, funds 30,000 checked jobs, and waits a full month, while any failed check burns the bond and voids the key for a year. At its nadir, a sybil farm is an expensive bonfire: it pays for the timber, but never builds the house.
